meta.title: West Coast Picks
meta.subtitle: Ketchikan · Seattle · Nevada City & Tahoe · Reno
notes: Stops: Ketchikan Sept 27–Oct 3, Seattle Oct 3–10, Nevada City & Tahoe City Oct 10–18, Reno Oct 18–22. “Only dates in town” is on by default and hides listings in a town on a date outside that stop — turn it off to see everything found in the five towns. Travel days count as both stops.

Nearby towns are folded into the closest hub: Grass Valley shows appear under Nevada City; Truckee, Incline Village and Crystal Bay under Tahoe City; Sparks, Carson City and Virginia City under Reno. The real town is named in the venue.
Crystal Bay Casino shows are tagged for both Tahoe City and Reno — it sits on Tahoe's north shore, roughly 20 minutes from Tahoe City and 35 minutes from Reno over NV-431. It is 21+.

Ketchikan is genuinely quiet in October: the cruise season closes at the end of September, so Misty Fjords tours, the Lumberjack Show and Saxman performances are likely dark, and the farmers market ended Aug 31. What is listed there is year-round trails, Totem Bight, the Discovery Center (free, Fri/Sat only from Oct 1) and weekly open mics.
Times marked 'time not confirmed' were estimated from a venue's usual schedule, not published.
Strawberry Music Festival's Fall 2026 edition (Oct 15–18, Grass Valley) is cancelled and was excluded.

Sources that returned nothing or blocked automated access: EverOut/The Stranger, Seattle Symphony, Earshot Jazz ticketing, visitktn.com and KRBD calendars, Ketchikan Museum, Pioneer Center Reno, Holland Project, Eventbrite Reno, Washoe County Parks, YubaNet, KVMR, Grass Valley Chamber, South Yuba River State Park events, Go Tahoe North.
